description: Declared case list for REVISION 1 of ticket 13's public tracer bullet (testcase commit 37b1ceff8), used only to regenerate inv-T13-0001 from its retained bundle: revision 1's oracle fixed the hand-derived assertion count at 15 (5 scalars per row group x 2, 3 in the aggregate, 2 INSERT counts). The declared count is per case revision, which is why this file exists beside ticket13-public-tracer.json.

applicability.fixture: Same CREATE TABLE and the same two INSERT statements as revision 1 of the case (revision 2 changed only keyword case and the SELECT projections), on a table the checker owns exclusively in its own database.
applicability.execution_path: The checker ran in a different run mode from the CTP case (declared applicability for that situation only). Same OOS operation, INSERT-side demotion; certifies no scan, recovery or vacuum path. Accepted reading of 'execution path must match' = same OOS operation, not same run mode (user decision O2, ticket 35).
applicability.engine_configuration: Same pinned engine commit and install, same page size, unmodified build, no instrumentation.
applicability.conditions: Single session, no concurrency, no fault injection, empty table at the start, no vacuum or restart in between.
